draw_instance_predictions: create a Visualizer to draw instance-level detection predictions with boxes, masks, and labels on an image
draw_semantic_segmentation: build a Visualizer to draw semantic segmentation predictions with colored masks and class labels on an image
draw_panoptic_segmentation: create a Visualizer to draw panoptic segmentation predictions combining semantic and instance masks on an image
draw_dataset_annotations: build a Visualizer to draw Detectron2 dataset dictionary annotations including boxes, masks, keypoints, and segmentation
overlay_instances: create a Visualizer to overlay instances with boxes, masks, labels, and keypoints on an image
